Date February 16, 1933.

Subject (in full) Confidential despatches dated January 16 and 20, 1933 addressed
to the Shanghai Municipal Police re communist publication
entitled "New China."
Made by... D.I., Kuh Tao-hwa. Forwarded by... [签名]

With reference to the attached confidential letters
dated January 16 and 20 respectively addressed to the Shanghai
Municipal Police from General Wen Hung En, Chief of the Shanghai
Public Safety Bureau, on the subject of a communist publication
entitled "Hsin Chung Koh" ( 新 中 国 ) (New China), I have to
state that efforts made to obtain a copy of this publication
from the Tsung Woo ( 正 午 ) Bookstore, 104 Chaotung Road,
(address mentioned in despatch dated January 16, 1933) have
been unsuccessful.

This publication may be classified as one of a series of
communist books containing articles eulogizing Soviet political
rule and the alleged victories of the Red Army, which are
published by the local Chinese Communist Party. Copies of this
book have been seized by the Municipal Police during recent
raids on communist bases. Diligent enquiries made by the
Chinese staff of this Section have failed to reveal the
editorial or distributing agencies of this subversive publication.

82

Kuh Tao-hwa
D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全文） 关于题为《新中国》的共产主义出版物，致上海公共租界工部局警务处的1933年1月16日和20日的机密公函。
由…… 督察 顾道华 (Kuh Tao-hwa) 制作。转呈者…… [签名]

兹提及附上的分别于1月16日和20日由上海市公安局局长文鸿恩 (Wen Hung En) 将军致上海公共租界工部局警务处的机密信件，内容涉及题为《新中国》(Hsin Chung Koh) 的共产主义出版物，本人须陈述如下：试图从位于兆通路 (Chaotung Road) 104号的正午 (Tsung Woo) 书店（1933年1月16日公函中提到的地址）获取该出版物副本的努力均未成功。

该出版物可归类为当地中国共产党出版的一系列共产主义书籍之一，其中包含歌颂苏维埃政治统治及红军所谓胜利的文章。在最近对共产主义据点的突袭行动中，工部局警务处已查获该书副本。本科华籍职员经过勤勉调查，未能查明此颠覆性出版物的编辑或发行机构。

82

顾道华 (Kuh Tao-hwa)
督察

Translation of confidential letter No. 9, character Tseng(曾),
dated January 16, 1933, addressed to the Commissioner of
Police from the Chief of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau.

We have received confidential order No. 470 from
the Municipality of Greater Shanghai quoting confidential
letter No. 528, character Tseh(札), from the Executive Committee
of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, quoting a letter from
the Central Propaganda Committee stating as follows:-

"Upon the receipt of a letter from the Shanghai Postal
"Censors Office forwarding a copy of a periodical entitled
" 'New China'(新中国) and stating that as it is a communist
"publication edited by the Soviet Research Society it should
"be strictly suppressed by this Committee in conjunction
"with the authorities concerned, we, apart from requesting
"the Postal Censors Office to detain the periodical, hereby
"request you to take vigilant steps to suppress its
"circulation. "

Upon the receipt of the order from the Municipality
of Greater Shanghai instructing us to act accordingly, we have
appointed officers to conduct confidential inquiries which reveal
that the communist publication "New China" is being sent to
outports in large quantities by the Tsung Woo(正午)Bookstore,
No. 104 Chiaotung Road. As this address is located in the
International Settlement, we request you to take necessary
action and let us know the results.

(Sealed) Wen Hung Eng.

翻译自上海市公安局局长于1933年1月16日致警务处处长的机密信件第9号，曾字。

我们收到大上海特别市政府的第470号机密命令，该命令引用了大上海特别市执行委员会的第528号机密信件，札字，后者又引用了中央宣传委员会的一封信，内容如下：-

“收到上海邮政检查处来函，转来一份题为
“‘新中国’(New China) 的期刊副本，并称由于这是
“由苏维埃研究社编辑的共产主义出版物，本委员会应
“会同有关当局严加取缔。除要求邮政检查处扣留该期
“刊外，特此请贵局采取警惕措施，取缔其流通。”

在收到大上海特别市政府指示我们据此行事的命令后，我们已指派人员进行秘密调查，结果显示，共产主义出版物《新中国》正由位于兆通路 (Chiaotung Road) 104号的正午 (Tsung Woo) 书店大量寄往外埠。由于该地址位于公共租界内，请贵局采取必要行动，并告知结果。

(盖章) 文鸿英 (Wen Hung Eng)。

Subject (in full) Sino-Soviet Research Society.

Made by D. I. Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

In accordance with the instructions of the Officer i/c
Special Branch a member of Section 2 attended each of a series
of lectures held under the auspices of the Sino-Soviet Research
Society at the Chinese Y.M.C.A. Building, Boulevard de
Montigny, daily between January 15 and 18, with a view to
identifying any communist who might attend. However, although
there can be little doubt that many communists did attend
the lectures, the Police officers detailed for this work
failed to identify any of them.

The personnel of the Sino-Soviet Research Society
has formed the subject of a special record by this office
for future reference.

42

the Commercial Press, gave a lecture entitled "A personal
view of Soviet Russia of ten years ago". His speech
dwelt upon the following points :

1. Since the establishment of the Soviet Government there
is not one corrupt official in Russia and no beggar
in Moscow. The administration is indeed excellent.

2. The workers in Soviet Russia receive the best treatment:
the males work 7 hours a day having one day holiday
after four days labour while the female and juvenile
workers only work 5 or 6 hours a day. Female workers
are entitled to 4 months' leave during the period
of child birth. The workers are further safeguarded
by the Government which issues a pension to those
who have worked 35 years.

3. The peasants are very well treated and given every
assistance to improve their agricultural methods
so as to increase production.

4. The females in Soviet Russia are permitted to participate
in all social movements and almost over one-third
of the various positions in all enterprises are
occupied by women.

5. The children are all protected by the Government which
looks after their welfare.

Chen King-wu (陈景苏), ex-editor of Shun Pao who
was the speaker on the first day subsequently took the
platform and addressed the audience stating that it was
absolutely shameful for the National Government to
lost the north east in view of the fact that there
were 400,000 Chinese troops as against 60,000 Japanese
troops in Manchuria. He also pointed out that the
Government could not evade responsibility for the loss
of Shanhaikwan as it only maintained one battalion of
troops there to defend the pass against the invaders.

2. 苏维埃俄国的工人受到最好的待遇：男性每天工作7小时，劳动四天后休息一天，而女性和未成年工人每天只工作5或6小时。女性工人在生育期间享有4个月的假期。政府进一步保障工人权益，向工作满35年的人发放养老金。

3. 农民受到很好的对待，并获得一切援助以改进农业方法，从而增加产量。

4. 苏维埃俄国的女性被允许参与所有社会运动，各类企业中超过三分之一的职位由女性担任。

A gist of his speech is as follows :-

"Since the inauguration of the Soviet Government

1. To establish an industrial country in accordance with

In addition she has formed a large and well equipped military

Imperialists. Every nation now realizes that Soviet

will surely lead to her recognition by U.S.A. in March, 1933,

In 1919 Soviet Russia abolished of her own accord

adopted severe measures towards the Communists consisting

THE NORTH-CHINA SUNDAY NEWS, DECEMBER 4, 1932

RED PAMPHLETS
IN MAILS

Startling Discovery by
Mission Officials

WRAPPERS COPIED

Communist Leaflets Sent
As Religious Tracts

Literature advocating a Soviet régime in China and enlarging upon the benefits derived by peasants from a communist government such as now exists in Russia has been circulated through the Post Office under the guise of religious leaflets, it was revealed yesterday. This discovery was made when the China Inland Mission received from one of their correspondents copies of pamphlets purporting to have been sent out by themselves but which, on examination, proved to have been printed and published by the "Soviet Russia Study Institute, Foochow Road, Shanghai" and the "Chun Shun Book Store," Shanghai. Neither of these concerns could be traced. Police consider the names to be fakes.

The pamphlets had apparently been posted in wrappers closely resembling those used by the Mission. They had been so printed that, when wrapped, Chinese characters stating that they were published by the Mission showed above the edge of the covering, this being the only part visible to the postal officials. There was no indication how long the despatch of pamphlets under this disguise had been going on.

Authorities Informed

It is understood that the matter has been referred to the authorities concerned for action.

It will be recalled that foreign and Chinese publishing firms were victimised by Communists in the same manner two or three years ago. Subversive propaganda was discovered being circulated in wrappers similar to those used by well-known firms here.

On another occasion some years ago it was discovered that a large quantity of Bibles intended for distribution in North China had been tampered with. Four pages of Communist propaganda had been cleverly inserted into the middle of each Bible.

The pamphlets received by the Mission were not of the more violent kind. They set out to explain the alleged advantages enjoyed by the working classes under the Soviet régime, and painted a glowing picture of conditions in Russia today. Labourers work no more than five or six hours a day, the pamphlets stated. They were then followed by probably the most important point. In simple language a picture of paradise was drawn for their readers.

"Two Five-year Plans"

One of the pamphlets was called "The Two Five-Year Plans."

"The name of Soviet Russia has been known to the labourers and farmers, but due to the unscrupulous and imperial schemes of the capitalists, the nature of the country has not been recognised by the two classes," it begins.

"Soviet Russia was established by labourers and farmers. Being afraid that this knowledge, once spread, would lead to the setting up of more Soviet countries, the capitalists who are in power have spread rumours to cheat the two classes," it continues. "The capitalists feel that the existence of Soviet Russia is a great danger to them."

"Capitalists have been telling the public that the Communists can only destroy, but not construct," it states in another place. "But, the Bolsheviks have successfully combined socialism with real construction."

"When the Five-Year Plan was first announced, it was condemned as a dream and a theory that could never be acted on. But, the First Five-Year Plan has been successfully brought to a conclusion in a period of four years. The second Five-Year Plan is about to start," the pamphlet continues. A glowing picture of conditions in Russia is painted.

Comparison with China

"The Socialism of Soviet Russia has grown amidst destruction wrought by Imperialist wars and civil wars. Fifteen years ago, the people of Russia were in the same condition as the people of China. The labourers and farmers were likewise poor, and oppressed; and many revolutionists were sent to prison, and killed by the cruel Government.

"Since the success of the first Five-Year Plan, the standard of living of the farmers and labourers has been improved from day to day. Machines are being used for ploughing. Women are no more bothered by children and families. Everybody is sent to school by the Government, and there is no such thing as unemployment."

Other extracts follow:—

"Soviet Russia has been keenly acting on an industrial policy, and its success has shattered the idea of the anti-revolutionary leader, Trotsky, and conquered the Right party...."

"The number of labourers has been increasing rapidly every year. The income of every labourer's family is $800 on an average. There are many free museums, theatres, cinemas, sanitariums. And the summer resorts, which only the capitalists could afford to visit formerly, are open to the labourers. These places are just like China's Moanshan, West Lake, and Lushan. In short, everything is furnished for the workers."

"Chinese labourers and farmers have suffered much oppression and poverty. Labourers and farmers in China should follow the example shown by their Soviet comrades. The capitalist countries have been attacking Soviet Russia. Of the East, Japan is the most active in this respect. We must therefore strengthen ourselves and support Soviet Russia, and at the same time help our own countrymen."

《华北星期日新闻》，1932年12月4日

邮件中的
红色小册子

传教士官员的
惊人发现

仿制包装纸

作为宗教传单寄送的
共产主义宣传页

昨日披露，宣扬在中国建立苏维埃政权并详述农民从如现今俄罗斯存在的共产主义政府中获得益处的文献，正伪装成宗教传单通过邮局流通。这一发现是在中国内地会从一名通讯员处收到几本声称由该会寄出的小册子副本时作出的，但经检查证明，这些小册子是由“上海福州路苏联俄罗斯研究所”和“上海春顺书店”印刷出版的。这两家机构均无法追踪。警方认为这些名称是伪造的。

这些小册子显然是用与内地会使用的极为相似的包装纸寄出的。其印刷方式使得在包装后，标明由内地会出版的汉字露出在包装纸边缘之上，这是邮政官员唯一能看到的部分。目前尚不清楚以这种伪装方式寄送小册子的行为已持续了多久。

已通知当局

据悉，此事已移交有关当局采取行动。

人们还记得，两三年前，外国和中国的出版公司曾以同样方式成为共产主义者的受害者。当时发现颠覆性宣传品使用类似本地知名公司使用的包装纸进行流通。

另有一次，几年前发现一批拟在华北分发的《圣经》被人动了手脚。每本《圣经》中间都被巧妙地插入了四页共产主义宣传品。

内地会收到的小册子不属于那种更为激烈的类型。它们试图解释工人阶级在苏维埃政权下享有的所谓优势，并描绘了一幅当今俄罗斯状况的美好图景。小册子称，工人每天工作不超过五到六小时。随后可能提出了最重要的一点。用通俗的语言为读者描绘了一幅天堂般的景象。

“两个五年计划”

其中一本小册子名为《两个五年计划》。

“苏联俄罗斯的名字已为工人和农民所知，但由于资本家无耻且带有帝国主义色彩的阴谋，这两个阶级未能认清该国的性质，”开头写道。

“苏联俄罗斯是由工人和农民建立的。当权者资本家担心这一知识一旦传播，会导致更多苏维埃国家的建立，因此散布谣言欺骗这两个阶级，”文中继续写道。“资本家觉得苏联俄罗斯的存在对他们构成巨大危险。”

“资本家一直告诉公众，共产党人只会破坏，不会建设，”另一处写道。“但是，布尔什维克已成功将社会主义与真正的建设结合起来。”

“当第一个五年计划首次宣布时，它被谴责为一个永远无法实施的梦想和理论。但是，第一个五年计划在四年内已成功完成。第二个五年计划即将开始，”小册子继续写道。文中描绘了一幅俄罗斯状况的美好图景。

与中国的比较

“苏联俄罗斯的社会主义是在帝国主义战争和内战造成的废墟中成长起来的。十五年前，俄罗斯人民的状况与中国人民相同。工人和农民同样贫困且受压迫；许多革命者被送进监狱，并被残酷的政府杀害。

“自从第一个五年计划成功以来，农民和工人的生活水平日益提高。机器正被用于耕作。妇女不再受孩子和家庭的困扰。每个人都由政府送去上学，不存在失业现象。”

其他摘录如下：—

“苏联俄罗斯一直在积极执行工业政策，其成功粉碎了反革命领袖托洛茨基的观念，并战胜了右派....”

“工人数量每年迅速增加。每个工人家庭的平均收入为800元。有许多免费的博物馆、剧院、电影院和疗养院。以前只有资本家负担得起的避暑胜地，现在也向工人开放。这些地方就像中国的莫干山、西湖和庐山。总之，一切设施都为工人提供。”

“中国工人和农民遭受了严重的压迫和贫困。中国的工人和农民应效仿其苏维埃同志的榜样。资本主义国家一直在攻击苏联俄罗斯。在东方，日本在这方面最为活跃。因此，我们必须加强自身力量，支持苏联俄罗斯，同时帮助我们的同胞。”

（批注：Key. 请附副本。1932年12月8日）
